quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Operating ROIC normalized to 31.37% tangible capital return neutralizing SEK 62.6B goodwill/intangibles from Sandvik Coromant cutting tools and mining automation acquisitions (GAAP ROIC 13.13%). Alleima spinoff in 2022 focused capital on high-margin mining duopoly and precision tooling consumables. 5-10Y forward EPS CAGR of 7.0% aligned with qualitative guidance: mining equipment/automation volume (3.5%), tooling consumable pricing (2.0%), digital manufacturing software (1.0%), and share buybacks (0.5%). Modest leverage (1.5x net debt/OE) with 11.7x interest coverage.
